facts.text: The base monolingual model used is the Bayesian model of garg2012unsupervised.
facts.source_quote: We use the Bayesian model of garg2012unsupervised as our base monolingual model.

facts.text: In this model, the semantic roles are predicate-specific.
To model role ordering and repetition preferences, the role inventory for each predicate is divided into Primary and Secondary roles.
